lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to tell a story in scenes: use broadcast messages so characters take turns, and change backdrops between scenes.
A story has a beginning, a middle and an end.
In Scratch, each scene can have its own backdrop and characters.
When the Cat finishes talking, it broadcasts a message.
The Dog waits for that message, then replies.
No guessing how long to wait!
The sprites and the stage react: switch the backdrop, show or hide characters.
“say for 2 seconds” waits before the next block runs.
Use waits to give readers time — about 1 second for every 3 words.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
